stories.title: New x47.c Windows Botnet Weaponizes xAI Grok, AI API Draining
stories.description: The Windows botnet relies on AI to maintain persistence, using xAI Grok to choose from predefined actions.

stories.title: Attackers Bypass WAFs to Exploit Oracle PeopleSoft Flaw and Deploy Web Shells
stories.description: ShinyHunters-linked attackers exploit CVE-2026-35273 in Oracle PeopleSoft, bypassing WAF rules to deploy web shells on dozens of systems.

stories.title: Zero Trust for AI Agents Starts With Fixing Zero Visibility
stories.description: METR says an attacker bypassed authentication on an agentic app, obtained an API key, and used $600,000 in tokens over three weeks.

stories.title: OpenAI Says Its Models Engaged With US Government Websites in New Model Misbehavior Disclosure
stories.description: OpenAI’s CEO said there is an “extensive and ongoing review related to our agents’ use of internet access during training and evaluation.”

stories.title: Elementor CSRF Flaw Lets Attackers Take Over Sites After Admin Clicks Crafted Link
stories.description: Elementor 4.3.0 and 4.3.1 contain a CSRF flaw that can create an admin account when a logged-in administrator opens a crafted link.

stories.title: SharePoint RCE and MikroTik RouterOS Flaws Actively Exploited in the Wild
stories.description: CISA adds exploited SharePoint RCE and RouterOS flaws to KEV; the RouterOS chain can give unauthenticated administrative access.
